subject: release-tooling/generated-test-escaping
statement: Generated test fixtures must distinguish source-level backslash escapes from runtime characters. Before trusting full-suite failures, compile generated test/source files and run a direct behavior gate with real multiline Unicode data so an outer raw-string generator cannot silently turn intended newlines into literal backslash+n data.
